style_en: Miniature diorama 3D CG render placed in an empty white space. Figures are smooth faceless figurines (no eyes, nose or mouth details), told apart by clothing, hairstyle and props. Soft shadows, slightly high camera angle looking down. Mostly white and gray, only the key objects in red. Northern Thailand, 2018.
avoid_en: logos, badges, insignia or emblems of real companies, militaries or agencies, marks or lettering on vehicles and equipment, readable text or numbers, detailed national flags, blood, faces resembling real people

boys.desc_en: the twelve boys, small slim boy figurines aged 11 to 16 with smooth featureless faces (no eyes, nose or mouth details), short black hair, plain red short-sleeved football shirts with no numbers, logos or text, black shorts

coach.desc_en: the young coach, a slim 25-year-old man figurine with a smooth featureless face (no eyes, nose or mouth details), very short cropped black hair, a plain dark navy tracksuit jacket with no logos, black shorts

divers.desc_en: the cave divers, adult man figurines with smooth featureless faces (no eyes, nose or mouth details), plain black wetsuits, plain yellow helmets with headlamps, plain gray air tanks on their sides, no logos, no badges, no text

doctor.desc_en: the anesthetist, a tall middle-aged man figurine with a smooth featureless face (no eyes, nose or mouth details), short gray hair, a plain black wetsuit, carrying a small plain red medical bag with no cross or text

navy.desc_en: the navy divers, fit adult man figurines with smooth featureless faces (no eyes, nose or mouth details), plain dark green wetsuits, plain black helmets with headlamps, no insignia, no badges, no flags, no text

saman.desc_en: the volunteer diver, a fit 37-year-old man figurine with a smooth featureless face (no eyes, nose or mouth details), short black hair, a plain dark green wetsuit, no insignia or text

cuts.en: Underwater: one of the cave divers swimming with one of the twelve boys held close in front of him, the boy wearing a full-face mask and connected to the diver by a short rope, both moving through a narrow passage.

cuts.image: 暗い洞窟の水たまりに、ダイバーが、担架にくくられた眠った少年と一緒に入っていく
cuts.image_en: Inside the dark cave, one of the cave divers sliding into black water together with one of the twelve boys strapped asleep on a small plain orange stretcher, full-face mask on. Only headlamp light.
cuts.en: Inside the dark cave, one of the cave divers sliding into black water together with one of the twelve boys strapped asleep on a small plain orange stretcher, full-face mask on. Only headlamp light.

cuts.image: 洞窟の入口の模型から、オレンジの担架にのった少年が、大勢の救助の人の手で光の中へ運び出されている
cuts.image_en: At the cave mouth model, the small plain orange stretcher with one of the twelve boys is passed out of the darkness into bright light by many hands of rescuer figurines, an ambulance with no markings waiting outside. Relief, dramatic light.
cuts.en: At the cave mouth model, the small plain orange stretcher with one of the twelve boys is passed out of the darkness into bright light by many hands of rescuer figurines, an ambulance with no markings waiting outside. Relief, dramatic light.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、オレンジの担架が4つずつ、2列に並んでいる
cuts.image_en: Two neat rows of four small plain orange stretchers each, lined up in the white space, seen from above. Orderly.
cuts.en: Two neat rows of four small plain orange stretchers each, lined up in the white space, seen from above. Orderly.

cuts.image: 洞窟の入口の模型から、紺のジャージのコーチが担架で運び出され、外の人たちが拍手している
cuts.image_en: the young coach being carried out of the cave mouth model on a plain orange stretcher, rescuer figurines outside clapping. Evening light.
cuts.en: the young coach being carried out of the cave mouth model on a plain orange stretcher, rescuer figurines outside clapping. Evening light.

cuts.image: 白い空間の病院の部屋の模型。白いベッドが並び、赤いシャツの少年たちが座って手を振っている
cuts.image_en: A hospital ward diorama in the white space with rows of white beds, the twelve boys sitting up in the beds waving. Bright, hopeful light. No text.
cuts.en: A hospital ward diorama in the white space with rows of white beds, the twelve boys sitting up in the beds waving. Bright, hopeful light. No text.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、山の上の小さな村の模型。家の前に、紺のジャージのコーチと少年3人が立っている
cuts.image_en: A small hill village diorama in the white space with wooden stilt houses, and the young coach standing in front with three of the boys. No flags, no borders drawn.
cuts.en: A small hill village diorama in the white space with wooden stilt houses, and the young coach standing in front with three of the boys. No flags, no borders drawn.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、4人のフィギュアが、それぞれ無地の赤い手帳を手にしている
cuts.image_en: Four figurines, the young coach and three of the boys, standing in a row in the white space, each holding a small plain red booklet with no emblem or text.
cuts.en: Four figurines, the young coach and three of the boys, standing in a row in the white space, each holding a small plain red booklet with no emblem or text.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、細長い銀色の筒の形の小さな潜水艇の模型が、使われないまま置かれている
cuts.image_en: A small slim silver tube-shaped mini submarine model lying unused on the white floor next to a narrow rock gap that is clearly too tight for it. No logos, no text.
cuts.en: A small slim silver tube-shaped mini submarine model lying unused on the white floor next to a narrow rock gap that is clearly too tight for it. No logos, no text.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、2つのヘルメットの模型が並べて置かれ、柔らかい光が当たっている
cuts.image_en: Two diving helmets placed side by side on the white floor under a soft beam of light. Quiet memorial. No text.
cuts.en: Two diving helmets placed side by side on the white floor under a soft beam of light. Quiet memorial. No text.

cuts.image: 白い空間の川原の模型。手前は晴れていて、遠くの山の上にだけ黒い雨雲がかかっている
cuts.image_en: A Japanese riverbank diorama in the white space: sunny over the river and its gravel bars in front, while far upstream a single dark rain cloud hangs over the mountains. A few small tents on the gravel. No text.
cuts.en: A Japanese riverbank diorama in the white space: sunny over the river and its gravel bars in front, while far upstream a single dark rain cloud hangs over the mountains. A few small tents on the gravel. No text.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、2枚のカードの模型。空の形と、山と雲の形
cuts.image_en: Two large blank cards standing in the white space, one with a simple sky icon, one with a mountain and cloud icon. No text.
cuts.en: Two large blank cards standing in the white space, one with a simple sky icon, one with a mountain and cloud icon. No text.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、今の服装の人のフィギュアが、左右に分かれた2つの道の前で立ち止まっている。左の道は暗い水、右の道は長い時計の形
cuts.image_en: A figurine in modern casual clothes standing at a fork in the white space: the left path leads into dark water, the right path is lined with a long row of clock shapes. Thoughtful mood. No text.
cuts.en: A figurine in modern casual clothes standing at a fork in the white space: the left path leads into dark water, the right path is lined with a long row of clock shapes. Thoughtful mood. No text.
